items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: he's my stepfather's brother and naturally my stepfather brought me up from a child about six months or a year old. So I always just consider him as a father and Johnny St. Cyr as an uncle

ctx.x: I knew his stepfather was something.

Yeah, you see he's my stepfather's brother and naturally my stepfather brought me up from a child about six months or a year old. So I always just consider him as a father and Johnny St. Cyr as an uncle, see? And you heard about him losing his wife?
